sourceEvidence.summary: Persistent Chrome verified the exact Replenish child-account route and the account uses location-level Performance Max campaigns, Maximize conversions, location-specific preview pages, and a repeated asset family. The same child account also displays Fresh Blends Ice Box campaigns, but the routes remain separate. Live inspection found cross-location copy, an incorrect asset-group name, unrelated sitelinks and phone details, incomplete ad strength, no video, and missing audience signals, so this blueprint treats the old campaign as evidence to improve rather than a template to clone blindly.

budgetBaseline.basis: Observed in current location campaigns; starting hypothesis only and never permission to spend.

qa: no unrelated links or phone numbers
page speed and form or directions test

copyRequirements: use the exact location in local copy

antiRegressionRules: Never reuse Boca as another location's asset-group name or copy.
Never attach sitelinks, domains, projects, services, or phone numbers from another business.
Never blend Fresh Blends or Kwik Trip assets, campaigns, budgets, or reporting into this route.
Do not enable a campaign until its primary conversion action records and its page passes rendered mobile QA.
Historical budget and performance are evidence, not launch authority.

successSignals: stable cost per verified primary action
